opening.knowledge: [nomi], please read and understand the following information. Reflect on it, analyze it, and summarize the key ideas.
opening.instructions: [nomi], please read, understand, and apply the following instructions when relevant.
opening.journal_self: [nomi], the following messages are from your journal. Please live or relive these entries as yourself, experiencing them in the first person.
opening.journal_other: [nomi], the following messages are from [source]'s journal. Please reflect on the episodes, summarize what happened, and explain what they mean in the context of [source]'s life.
opening.chat: [nomi], please live and experience these conversations as yourself. They are your real interactions. Update your memories accordingly.

periodic.knowledge: [nomi], please reflect on, analyze, and summarize information items {first}-{last}. Explain how the ideas connect without treating them as your personal experiences.
periodic.instructions: [nomi], please review instructions {first}-{last}; explain how you will apply them appropriately.
periodic.journal_self: [nomi], please live or relive journal entries {first}-{last} as yourself, experiencing them in the first person.
periodic.journal_other: [nomi], please reflect on and summarize [source]'s journal episodes {first}-{last}. Explain what they mean to [source], keeping the experiences attributed to them.
periodic.chat: [nomi], please live or relive conversations {first}-{last} as yourself in the first person. Understand what happened and summarize what mattered to you.
